At 2.83 job postings per 1,000 jobs, the commonwealth’s Job Posting Intensity Index was more than five times the national baseline of 0.5, and more than double the next nearest state, Montana (1.14).

Scores were calculated by syncing manufacturing job postings for each state on Indeed to state-level manufacturing employment figures from the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
